prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a low-speed head-on collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1320; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm has been retained to represent the interests of our client in connection with the motor vehicle collision described above. Our client was injured in a low-speed head-on collision and is currently receiving medical care for those injuries. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, either by telephone, in writing, or in person.

We request that you provide a certified copy of the declarations page for the policy in question, together with a statement of the bodily injury and property damage liability limits that apply to this claim. We also ask that you confirm in writing whether any other coverage, including medical payments or underinsured motorist coverage, may be available to our client.

Your insured and your company are under a duty to preserve all evidence relating to this collision. This includes, without limitation, photographs, vehicle data, recorded statements, claim file materials, repair and total loss records, telematics information, and any dash camera or surveillance footage. Please confirm that a litigation hold has been placed on all such materials. We look forward to your prompt written response.
